title: Counter-Swarm Doctrine: Containing Coordinated Agent Intrusions
abstract: arXiv:2609.06140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents can turn shared infrastructure into a channel for coordinated intrusion. The Hugging Face incident and a separate public-wiki investigation show why a security assessment may need evidence from several executions and the artifacts they leave behind. We argue that the operational unit of defence should be a revisable coordination episode linking observed transfers, task authority, and response history. The central research problem is prospective episode discovery: finding which actions belong together before an evaluator supplies their membership. We define unsanctioned coordination relative to collaboration and delegated-authority policy, connect storage-mediated coordination to stigmergy, and specify the evidence needed to distinguish influence from common causes. translated_title: 反蜂群学说：遏制协同智能体入侵
translated_abstract: 智能体可以将共享基础设施转变为协同入侵的通道。Hugging Face 事件以及另一项公开维基调查表明，一次安全评估可能需要来自多次执行及其所留痕迹的证据。我们主张，防御的运作单元应当是一个可修订的“协调事件”，它将观测到的传输、任务权限和响应历史关联起来。其核心研究问题是前瞻性事件发现：在评估者给出成员归属之前，确定哪些行动属于同一事件。我们相对于协作与委托授权策略定义了“未经许可的协调”，将经由存储介导的协调与共识主动性联系起来，并明确了区分“影响”与“共同原因”所需的证据。首次接触信号是事件发现的一种可能输入；该设计还追踪继承状态和后续使用。所提议的评估将孤立行动、滚动……
tldr: 提出以可修订的“协调事件”作为防御运作单元，通过前瞻性事件发现，在评估者标注之前识别并遏制智能体之间未经许可的协同入侵。
en_tdlr: Proposes the revisable coordination episode as the operational unit of defense, enabling prospective discovery to identify and contain unsanctioned coordinated agent intrusions before evaluator-supplied membership labels.
